name: Red Blade
description: A black void cut by one narrow horizontal blade of saturated red light.
lighting: One hard horizontal blade of red light, everything else black
subject: either
prompt: A seamless black sweep swallows the frame, absorbing every stray light. Across the middle of the frame one narrow horizontal blade of saturated red light cuts through the dark, a hard-edged band no taller than a hand's width, falling exactly where a face or an object would stand. Outside the blade everything drops to near black, with only a faint crimson spill on the floor. The air is clean and still. The palette is black and one pure scarlet red, severe and cinematic.
